title: Change Impact
description: What else a change could affect, by bounded reverse reachability from the symbols it modified or removed. Deliberately not a transitive closure: published static change-impact precision is roughly 38-50%, so an unbounded result reaches nearly everything and is right about nearly none of it.

hops.description: Traversal depth actually used, after clamping to maxHops.

seeds.description: The symbols the change modified or removed. An empty list means nothing was identified as changed, not that nothing changed.

impacted.description: Ranked, and truncated to the report limit. `totalImpacted` and `suppressed` describe what is not shown.

suppressed.description: How many impacted symbols were found but not listed. Counted rather than dropped: a truncated list that does not say so reads as a complete one.

caveat.description: The precision limitation, carried with the data so it cannot be rendered without it.

claimStrength.description: 'referred-to-removed-symbol' is a fact about the base revision. 'could-be-affected' is exactly as weak as it sounds.
